source: Game Concept/narrative/FINAL_SCRIPT.md, SC10. Lines marked "system": true are gameplay feedback, hints or placeholder prompts that are not in the script; review them before release.

arrive.text: Veya arrives. She recognises Kesi and raises a weapon.

arrive.speaker: VEYA
arrive.text: The woman who broke the renewal chamber.

arrive.speaker: VEYA
arrive.text: My city heard the difference for one breath. Then it drowned.

arrive.speaker: NALI
arrive.text: Lower it. I need the platform to stay standing.
Orun and his son Lio arrive with relief workers. Lio goes straight to the injured rather than the argument. Orun helps lift a brace before speaking.

arrive.speaker: ORUN
arrive.text: We can hate each other when everyone is above the waterline.

wheel.text: Tavo fits the wheel to the repaired bypass. Clean water begins flowing towards the uplands.
Veya keeps enough control to protect the remaining reservoir. The wheel stays installed.

news.speaker: ORUN
news.text: Mera has been hiding more than records.

news.speaker: TAVO
news.text: Everyone knows my mother except me.

news.speaker: ORUN
news.text: I knew the office she held. I am beginning to understand the person who left it.
A messenger brings news. Mera has been detained at Red Hollow after admitting she helped the attackers. River troops are approaching under an order demanding her surrender.
Sena is travelling under Daru's escort to the capital's relief court to challenge the order. The water repair buys several days; it does not end the danger.

news.speaker: KESI
news.text: If you want the part they won't put in the charge, come to the archive.

news.speaker: ORUN
news.text: Come with witnesses. Hers, mine and your own.

bypass_after.text: Clean water runs towards the uplands.

veya.speaker: VEYA
veya.text: The wheel stays. The reservoir stays safe. That was the bargain.

kesi.speaker: KESI
kesi.text: Not here. Not with her watching.

nali.speaker: NALI
nali.text: Help with the wheel. I have people to see to.
